name: duanyin-reasons
description: Stable stop-reason taxonomy for the 断因 SillyTavern extension. Category ids: truncated (length/max_tokens), stop, content_filter, tool_calls, thinking_quota (empty visible text after reasoning/thought tokens), plus recitation, refusal, cancelled, network, provider_error, context_length, and unknown.

rules.title_zh: 回复被内容过滤打断了
rules.title_en: The reply was stopped by a content filter
rules.message_zh: 服务提供方判定这段内容触发了安全或内容策略，所以生成停了。即使在 SillyTavern 里把安全选项关掉，对方仍可能拦截。
rules.message_en: The provider stopped this reply because it triggered a safety or content policy. They can still block it even if SillyTavern safety settings are turned off.
rules.suggestion_zh: 可以换个说法再试，或换一个模型/渠道。不必反复点「继续」，同样的拦截可能还会出现。
rules.suggestion_en: Try rephrasing, or switch models or providers. Pressing Continue may hit the same filter again.

rules.title_en: The reply stopped because of a recitation limit
rules.message_zh: 模型认为接下来的内容可能大段复述已有文本，所以提前结束了。
rules.message_en: The model stopped because the next part may have closely recapped existing text.
rules.suggestion_zh: 可以换一种问法，或点「继续」看是否能换个角度写下去。
rules.suggestion_en: Try asking in a different way, or press Continue to see if it can take another angle.

rules.message_zh: 模型自己拒绝继续写下去，这和字数用完不是一回事。
rules.message_en: The model itself declined to continue. This is not the same as hitting a length limit.
rules.suggestion_zh: 可以改写你的请求后再试，或换一个模型。
rules.suggestion_en: Try rephrasing your request, or switch to another model.

rules.message_zh: 发给模型的内容超出了它的上下文长度，这一轮没能正常写完。
rules.message_en: The prompt exceeded the model's context length, so this turn could not finish normally.
rules.suggestion_zh: 可以减少世界书、总结更早的对话，或换一个上下文更长的模型。
rules.suggestion_en: Trim World Info, summarize earlier chat, or switch to a model with a longer context window.

rules.message_zh: 这次回复是中途取消的，所以可能不完整。
rules.message_en: This reply was cancelled partway through, so it may be incomplete.
rules.suggestion_zh: 如果需要完整回复，可以再生成一次，或在已有内容上点「继续」。
rules.suggestion_en: Generate again if you need a full reply, or press Continue on what is already there.

rules.message_zh: 生成过程中网络或连接出了问题，回复可能不完整。
rules.message_en: The connection dropped during generation, so the reply may be incomplete.
rules.suggestion_zh: 检查网络后再试一次。如果已经有一段内容，也可以点「继续」。
rules.suggestion_en: Check your connection and try again. If some text already arrived, you can also press Continue.

rules.message_zh: 模型服务在这一轮返回了错误，所以回复可能不完整或没有内容。
rules.message_en: The model provider returned an error, so this reply may be incomplete or empty.
rules.suggestion_zh: 稍后再试，或换一个模型/渠道。
rules.suggestion_en: Try again in a moment, or switch models or providers.

rules.title_en: Thinking used up the output budget
rules.message_zh: 这一轮很多字数花在了模型的思考过程上，所以你看到的回复很短，或者几乎是空的。思考内容也会计入长度上限。
rules.message_en: A large share of this turn's token budget went to the model's thinking, so the visible reply is short or almost empty. Thinking tokens count toward the length limit too.
rules.suggestion_zh: 可以调高回复长度上限后再点「继续」，或换一个不带思考的模型。
rules.suggestion_en: Raise the max token limit and press Continue, or switch to a non-thinking model.

rules.message_zh: 达到了本次生成的长度上限。
rules.message_en: This reply hit the maximum length set for this generation.
rules.suggestion_zh: 可以试着调高 max tokens，或点「继续」接着写。
rules.suggestion_en: Try raising max tokens, or press Continue to keep writing.

rules.title_en: The model made a tool call
rules.message_zh: 这一轮停在工具调用上，通常会由 SillyTavern 继续处理，不必当作截断。
rules.message_en: This turn stopped for a tool call. SillyTavern usually handles that next, so it is not a truncation.
rules.suggestion_zh: 无需特别处理。如果没有看到后续回复，再检查工具调用设置。
rules.suggestion_en: Usually nothing to do. If no follow-up reply appears, check your tool-calling settings.

rules.message_zh: 这一轮已经正常写完了。

fallback.title_en: The reply may have ended early
fallback.message_zh: 没能读到明确的结束原因，所以无法判断是写完了、被截断，还是被过滤。
fallback.message_en: No clear stop reason was available, so it is unclear whether the reply finished, was cut off, or was filtered.
fallback.suggestion_zh: 如果句子看起来没写完，可以点「继续」，或调高长度上限后再试。
fallback.suggestion_en: If the sentence looks unfinished, press Continue, or raise the length limit and try again.
